testcase.name: TC1 - Basic Flow (Happy Path)
testcase.preconditions: The iTrust2 Admin has authenticated themselves in the iTrust2 Medical Records system UC3.

step.actions: admin: An Admin enters a user name, a password, confirm password, the role, and if the user is enabled (or active) in the system. The Admin presses the button to add the user . The user name serves as the User's Medical ID (MID). The possible roles are: Patient Health Care Provider (HCP) Admin Emergency Responder (ER) Lab Tech
step.expectedresults: SYSTEM displays a success message and logs transaction
